summary: Risk appetite looks mixed-to-cautious today: Bitcoin is consolidating near key support while Ethereum shows a short-term rebound, and macro sentiment is being pulled by weak US consumer data and rate-hike expectations. FX and gold are reflecting a defensive backdrop, while several major crypto tokens remain technically constructive but fragile.
